name: AcroGame
short: Acronym game with deleted chat submissions and anonymous voting.
description: Players submit acronym answers as ordinary messages, which are deleted after capture. After 30 seconds, players vote for anonymous entries and cannot vote for themselves. Winners earn leaderboard points and optionally Red bank credits. Active rounds stop when the cog is disabled. User-data deletion cancels affected rounds before removing leaderboard records, including in-flight tallies.
author: Will
end_user_data_statement: Persists Discord user IDs and game scores (wins/points). Keeps answer submissions and votes in memory for the duration of a round only; deletes original Discord chat submissions after capture. Keeps a bounded in-memory set of up to 10,000 message IDs deleted by the game so AdminLog can suppress delayed deletion records; this set contains no message text and clears on cog reload/restart.
install_msg: AcroGame installed. Run [p]load acrogame and [p]acro start to begin.
